It appeared in 7 late-period observed months with a maximum consecutive run of 2; the repeated-trip and full-window share evidence supports a sustained route-distribution change rather than a permanent replacement. Sparse use was recorded as early as 2022-02; the first adequate evidence month was 2023-03. The earlier family reappeared in 2023-07, 2023-10, 2024-06, so the shift included intermittent reversions. The GPS data do not identify the cause.
